Chapter 7051: Does This Count As A Celestial Immortal?

Chapter 7051: Does This Count As A Celestial Immortal?

Li Qiye stopped and stared at the incoming waves engulfing the entire path. It became as great as a river surging like a dragon.

“For what reason do you call my name?” A voice came from the waves, instilling fear into overlords and immortals.

They felt their soul was being dragged from their body toward a bloody jaw and could only writhe on the ground.

“Zhao Dachui...” A golden immortal whispered.

A colossal figure appeared among the tribulation river. Some of the lightning currents actually latched onto the figure to help the formation.

“Boom!” Once the head formed, an ultimate celestial aura manifested into reality.

“A celestial immortal?!” Fear struck them without warning.

Everyone knew Li Qiye was above a regular celestial immortal. Only those with apex power could challenge him.

They saw an immortal in a violet robe engraved with golden solar lines. It fluttered like clouds in the wind. Ten violet suns appeared behind him, each carrying karmas and other affinities...

They painted the impression that he was the creator of all worlds because of his grasp on the affinities. His eyes, in particular, resembled two violet suns full of life and hope.

“This is Zhao Dachui?” A young immortal asked.

“Yes, it’s him.” Someone who had seen him several times before said.

His appearance surprised everyone. The leader of Devouring Alliance should be a source of darkness with a fierce expression. However, he looked to be a creator of worlds, not a fallen one.

“This is his true appearance, Violet Sun Golden Immortal.” An acquaintance said emotionally.

Zhao Dachui was a great genius. If he had fallen at the start, he wouldn’t have become an incredible immortal.

“Has reached the shore but no paramita body.” Heaven’s Equal murmured.

“Does he count as a celestial immortal then?” Someone asked because some considered reaching the shore enough, while others believed the body was necessary.

“Shouldn’t he be dead?” More cultivators asked this question since he was killed by the enforcer’s ultimate slash. Was the legend wrong?

“Why is he riding the tribulations? No, they are making up his body too.” Heaven’s Equal wondered.

This woke up the crowd about the strange phenomenon.

“Who has this ability? To refine and even create life.” Li Qiye asked.

“Who are you?” Zhao Dachui stared at Li Qiye.

“You are not Zhao Dachui and are merely borrowing his body’s life power.” Li Qiye uttered coldly.

“I am Violet Sun Golden Immortal.” To which the being answered.
